class.name: HTMLDialogElement
class.brief_description: An HTML dialog that can open in the document or in the modal top layer.
class.description: Represents [code]<dialog>[/code]. A modal dialog and its CSS [code]::backdrop[/code] render above the document. In [HTMLLabel], only the topmost modal accepts interaction. Tab cycles through its focusable elements and Escape closes it after open menus and IME composition have handled the key.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the dialog. Pass a [String] to replace [member return_value], or leave the argument as [code]null[/code] to keep the current value. Returns [constant OK] if the dialog is already closed.

method.name: is_modal
method.description: Returns whether this dialog is in its layout's modal top layer.

method.name: show
method.description: Opens the dialog in the document. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if it is already open as a modal.

method.name: show_modal
method.description: Opens a connected dialog in the modal top layer. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if it is detached or already open as a non-modal dialog.

members.member: Reflects the HTML [code]open[/code] attribute. Setting this property to [code]true[/code] opens a regular dialog. Setting it to [code]false[/code] removes the attribute and leaves the top layer if needed.
The result associated with this dialog. The initial value is an empty string.

signal.name: closed
signal.description: Emitted after [method close] closes an open dialog and [HTMLLabel] processes focus restoration.
